nonblockers_and_limits: Input body identities are runtime checks, not independently reread real-array evidence at this pre-review stage.
Author artificial tests do not prove actual completion, resource usage, visibility or geometric accuracy.
Contract identity is bound by the reviewed byte SHA and root launch; runner records the actual contract SHA and verifies its own source SHA.
Memory enforcement is sampled ru_maxrss plus wall alarm, not an OS address-space ceiling; actual receipt and process exit must be reviewed.
Predicted support, coverage, collision counts and depth order are descriptions of this fixed geometry, not physical visibility, accuracy, generative quality or innovation.
